full_prompt_en: The image is a square black-and-white stop-motion-like portrait of a wide-eyed stitched dog tilting its head beneath a cloudy sky. The dog rises from the lower right and leans its long narrow neck diagonally toward the center-left, placing its enlarged head against a soft blurred background. One dark ear curls down on the left and the other arches high across the upper right; a few stiff dark tufts rise between them. Its pale muzzle is long and pointed, covered with fine directional fur-like scratches. The nose is small, rounded, and dark, and the mouth hangs partly open, revealing a row of tiny uneven teeth with two longer pointed teeth. The very large round eyes look upward with tiny dark pupils, giving the face an alert, uneasy surprise. Dark seams ring the eye sockets and trace the jaw, while small stitch-like marks and fabric texture are visible on the neck. A dark strap or collar circles the lower neck near the cropped edge. Behind the figure, out-of-focus light and dark cloud shapes fill the entire frame; no distinct ground or horizon is visible. The viewpoint is close and a little below the tilted head, exaggerating the eyes and ears. Soft light from the upper left brightens the muzzle and eyeballs, while gray shadows deepen in the eye rims, open mouth, and beneath the chin. Fine ridged texture and slightly irregular construction make the form feel handmade rather than smooth. The depth of field leaves the dog crisp against a diffuse sky, and the monochrome palette moves from luminous silver-gray to nearly black. The overall composition is eccentric and tender, with the diagonal neck and oversized gaze turning a simple close-up into an expressive miniature scene.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一张方形黑白、定格动画观感的特写：一只瞪大眼睛的缝合小狗在阴云下歪着头。小狗从右下方升起，细长脖颈斜向画面左中部，把放大的头部放在柔糊背景前。一只暗耳在左侧下弯，另一只高高拱向右上；几撮僵直的暗毛在两耳间竖起。浅色口鼻细长而尖，覆有顺着方向排列的细毛状刮痕。鼻子小、圆而暗，嘴半张，露出一排不齐的小牙和两颗较长尖牙。极大的圆眼向上看，瞳孔很小，使面孔显得警觉又有点不安惊讶。暗接缝环住眼窝并沿下颌走，小小的缝线状痕迹和布料肌理在脖颈上可见。一条暗带或项圈围着靠近裁幅边缘的下颈。身后，失焦的明暗云块填满全幅，没有明确地面或地平线。视点贴近且略低于倾斜的头，夸张了眼睛和耳朵。左上方柔光照亮口鼻与眼球，灰影加深眼缘、张开的嘴和下巴下面。细密棱纹与略不规整的结构使形体显得手工制作，而非平滑无痕。浅景深让小狗清楚地衬在漫散天空前，黑白色调从亮银灰走到近黑。整体构图古怪而温柔，斜伸的颈部与放大的目光把简单特写变成富表情的微缩场景。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome stop-motion-like imagery gives simple rounded volumes a tactile, constructed surface. Fine directional ridges, tiny seams, and irregular joins remain visible beneath soft sculpted light. Bright silver-gray highlights concentrate on forward forms, while deep charcoal fills recesses and thin contour gaps. An extreme close crop and diagonal central movement enlarge expressive proportions without requiring a detailed setting. Shallow focus separates crisp textured foreground from a blurred cloudy field of middle gray and white. Edges are slightly imperfect, preserving handmade character, yet the value structure remains clear and cinematic. The result is strange and gentle, balancing graphic dark accents with softly modeled pale surfaces.
style_prompt_zh: 黑白定格动画式图像给简洁圆钝的体积一层可触的制作表面。顺向细棱、微小接缝与不齐的连接处留在柔和塑形光下。亮银灰高光集中于朝前的形体，深炭色填进凹处和细轮廓缝。极近的裁幅与中央斜向运动放大富表情的比例，而无需细致场景。浅景深把清晰有纹理的前景同中灰与白构成的模糊云状区域分开。边缘稍不完美，保留手工性格，明度结构却清楚而有电影感。整体古怪而温柔，让图形化暗点与柔和塑形的浅色表面相平衡。
theme_en: A wide-eyed stitched dog tilting its head beneath a cloudy sky
theme_zh: 一只瞪大眼睛的缝合小狗在阴云下歪头
name: Frankenweenie
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
